symptom: After a project with an existing storyboard design is rehydrated, Creation can show the storyboard plan card and 新建分镜方案 while the dedicated storyboard editor remains unreachable until a second user action.
direct_cause: hydrateStoryboardPlans and hydrateStoryboardDesigns restored the design maps but unconditionally reset activeStoryboardId to null, so a valid restored design had no active editor target after a cold restart.
class_root: The shared workbench hydration boundary restored storyboard data and active-document state independently, without deriving the active storyboard selection from the restored designs for the active document.
affected_population: Users reopening a project that already contains one or more storyboard designs
The M0-M5 real Electron journey after its first canonical storyboard patch and restart
entry_points: Direct storyboard plan/design hydration used by project and workspace restore
internal_only_reason: Storyboard design selection and workbench hydration are internal Nomi state contracts; no external provider controls the active editor target.
invariants: Hydrating an active document with existing storyboard designs selects the first restored design as the active storyboard target.
Hydrating a document with no storyboard designs leaves activeStoryboardId null so the existing 新建分镜方案 entry remains available.
Hydration derives selection from restored data at the shared boundary and does not invent authored storyboard content or alter persisted plan fields.
generality_proof: Both project-session restore and direct workbench hydration converge on the two shared hydration helpers; deriving the active target there covers desktop cold start, browser fallback restore, and any future caller without a caller-specific reentry workaround.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Restore storyboard projections and derive activeStoryboardId from the active document's restored designs while preserving the empty-state null selection.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Project restore passes persisted storyboard designs and plans through the shared hydration helpers; it does not maintain a second active-selection policy.
Both public hydration entry points now derive the active target from the same active-document design map.

recurrence.reason: Any project rehydrated with valid storyboard data can reproduce the null active-selection seam, and there are multiple hydration callers that must share the same selection rule.
same_class_scan: Searched hydrateStoryboardPlans, hydrateStoryboardDesigns, restoreWorkbenchProjectPayload, activeStoryboardId setters, storyboardDesignsByDocumentId readers, and StoryboardWorkspace mounts.
Checked project-session restore and direct lifecycle hydration tests as separate callers of the shared workbench boundary.
Checked the empty-project starter route to preserve its null-selection 新建分镜方案 behavior.

prevention.invariant: Every storyboard hydration call derives activeStoryboardId from the active document's restored designs, or null when that document has none.
prevention.failure_mode: A restored non-empty design map cannot silently leave the dedicated editor without an active target, while an empty map remains an explicit create state.
prevention.strategy: Compute the selection immediately before the shared hydration state update from the same normalized design map that is persisted in the workbench store.

legacy_paths.rationale: No second hydration or editor implementation is introduced; the existing workbench hydration boundary remains the sole selection owner.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The invariant is internal workbench persistence and hydration behavior and does not depend on a third-party runtime.

migration: Existing persisted storyboard plans and designs are read unchanged. On restore, projects with designs select their first design for editor reentry; documents without designs retain the existing null selection and creation entry.
residual_risks: The real M4-to-M5 runner still needs a fresh run to prove the canonical patch is durably written before restart; this contract covers the hydration selection seam after data is present.
